name: Memergez
summary: Next.js web app that generates memes from text and an avatar URL with 70+ meme commands.
description: A meme generator you clone and deploy: pick one of more than 70 meme commands, enter text or an avatar URL, and get a meme image in seconds. Created using imgflip, memer.ts and shadcn/ui; runs locally or deploys to Vercel.
